project_type: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo — Vite/React frontend + Express/Node backend, npm workspaces
build_system: npm workspaces at repo root. Frontend: Vite 5 (`vite build`). Backend: tsc (`tsc -p tsconfig.json`). Root has convenience scripts that delegate to workspaces. No monorepo build tool beyond npm workspaces.
test_framework: Vitest in frontend only (`npx vitest run`). Backend has no tests. Test file: frontend/src/__tests__/aestheticScore.test.ts
build_command: cd frontend && npm run build   (or)   cd backend && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. cd /Users/lndu/Documents/BugPoet/backend && npm run build — must exit 0. 2. cd /Users/lndu/Documents/BugPoet/frontend && npx vitest run — all tests pass. 3. cd /Users/lndu/Documents/BugPoet/frontend && npm run build — exits 0, dist/ exists.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist/ (produced by npm run build in frontend/). backend/dist/ (produced by npm run build in backend/). Neither is checked in; they are build artifacts.
environment_constraints: API Key must NEVER appear in frontend code. Backend reads OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL from .env (loaded by dotenv). Frontend uses VITE_API_BASE_URL env var for API base (defaults to '' which hits the Vite proxy in dev). Do not commit .env — only .env.example.
contribution_requirements: All validation steps must pass: backend tsc build, frontend vitest tests, frontend vite build. No API key in frontend code.
key_patterns: Greenfield project — no existing patterns to follow. Establish patterns: React functional components with hooks, TypeScript strict mode, Express middleware chain, pure utility functions for score/parser. CJK character counting uses /[\u4e00-\u9fff]/g. Truncation: first 2000 + last 1000 chars of >5000-char input, done in InputPanel before calling onGenerate (frontend warns user). Rate limit via express-rate-limit windowMs:60000 max:10.
directory_structure: BugPoet/ (repo root) — package.json (workspaces), README.md. backend/ — Express+TS server; src/index.ts entry, src/routes/, src/services/, src/middleware/, tsconfig.json, package.json, .env.example. frontend/ — Vite+React+TS app; src/App.tsx, src/components/, src/utils/, src/__tests__/, vite.config.ts, package.json, index.html.
